slides.texte_overlay:
what ADHD paralysis
actually looks like

1. sitting on the couch for hours
knowing exactly what to do

your body just won't
get the message

2. staying in the car
after you've parked

because going inside means
starting the next thing

3. not doing anything fun either

you can't do the task,
but you don't feel allowed
to rest. so you just wait

4. skipping the gym
you actually wanted to go to

wanting it was never
the problem

5. one tiny step can unlock it

standing up, a glass of water,
opening the laptop.
sometimes that's enough

6. being hard on yourself after

it's a starting problem,
not a caring problem

be kind to yourself.
you're not stuck forever
